title: Scalar Gaussian projection law
statement: Let $\rho\in[-1,1]$. The map $(x,y)\mapsto\rho x+\sqrt{1-\rho^2}\,y$ sends the product of two standard Gaussian measures on $\mathbb R$ to the standard Gaussian measure.
